title: Detector Guidance for Multi-Object Text-to-Image Generation
property: object presence and location (class-agnostic boxes per noun), used to separate objects
reads: Five middle U-Net cross-attention maps for one core noun, stacked as 20 x 16 x 16, averaged over heads
trained_on: YOLOv1 with ResNet backbone on noised COCO images with object labels as prompts; box and confidence loss, no class loss; 100k steps
gradient_enters: No gradient: detector boxes mask rival words in later cross-attention maps (replaced by unconditional attention) and rescale the rest, for t <= 800
unseen: no: claims good generalization to unseen categories and shows demos, but holds out no category and reports no seen-versus-unseen number
headline: Human-judged better alignment 35.3% for DG against 13.0% for SD 2.1 (0 to 100%, higher better, rest tied) on the 30-prompt MRO benchmark; detector mAP@0.5 falls from 58.4 at t=200 to 18.0 at t=800
copy_or_avoid: Copy the per-word map input with no class head; avoid assuming maps carry layout above t=800, where its detector guesses and 10 of our 16 push steps would fall under even spacing (inferred)
